source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The account dialog uses a surface background color beneath its light and dark WebP background. The adjacent comment gives the image-loading delay as the reason. Awaiting JavaScript view.ready does not establish that a CSS background image has decoded. In this dialog, retain the solid surface when replacing its background artwork. The cited >=100ms comment is an author observation, not a timing measurement performed here. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep a solid Account Hub background while its image loads
